the best learning AI in it. It was an early reinforcement
learning system that you, you know, you were looking
after this mythical creature and growing it and nurturing it. And depending how you treated it, it would treat the villagers

of simulations and AI through the medium of games
at the beginning of my career. And really the whole of what I
do today is still a follow on from those early more
hard-coded ways of doing the AI to now, you know, fully
general learning systems that are trying to achieve the same thing.
